exampleEn: He won't be easily discouraged, because he's a tough guy.
exampleZh: 他不会轻易灰心，因为他是个坚强的人。

definition: 不幸的；可怜的；悲惨的；恶劣的
exampleEn: He lived a wretched life when young.
exampleZh: 他年轻时过着悲惨的生活。

definition: 令人灰心的；使人沮丧的
exampleEn: I have writer's block. It's very frustrating.
exampleZh: 我遇到了写作瓶颈，这非常令人沮丧。

exampleEn: The widow mourned her husband for a long time.
exampleZh: 这位寡妇长时间地哀悼她的丈夫。

exampleEn: The dog's hair bristled up with anger.
exampleZh: 狗的毛发因为愤怒而竖立起来。

exampleEn: Even though he apologized, I'm still furious.
exampleZh: 尽管他道歉了，我仍然很狂怒。

definition: 皱眉；不悦/皱眉；表示不悦
exampleEn: I frowned and drew my hand away.
exampleZh: 我皱了皱眉，然后把手缩了回来。

exampleEn: War is like a raging fire.
exampleZh: 战争就像一场肆虐的火焰。

exampleEn: If someone irritates you, it is best not to react immediately.
exampleZh: 如果有人激怒了你，最好不要立即反应。

exampleEn: In a word, you hate me, don't you?
exampleZh: 总之，你恨我，不是吗？

exampleEn: I do not know the meaning of hatred.
exampleZh: 我不知道憎恨的含义。

exampleEn: I don't want to be a nuisance.
exampleZh: 我不想成为一个麻烦。

exampleEn: I didn't mean to disgust anyone.
exampleZh: 我并不是有意让任何人感到厌恶。

exampleEn: I was vexed at his irresolute attitude.
exampleZh: 我对他的犹豫不决的态度感到烦恼。

exampleEn: Tell your son to quit harassing my daughter.
exampleZh: 告诉你的儿子停止烦扰我的女儿。

definition: 烦扰；钻孔/讨厌的人；令人生厌的事
exampleEn: I was bored, so I fell asleep.
exampleZh: 我感到无聊，所以睡着了。

definition: 花费时间精力（做某事）；（使）苦恼/麻烦，困难
exampleEn: He was only bothered about concrete questions.
exampleZh: 他只是对具体问题感到困扰。

exampleEn: It is the first step which is troublesome.
exampleZh: 第一步是令人烦恼的。

definition: 令人不愉快的；极讨厌的
exampleEn: I made an awful mistake in the test.
exampleZh: 我在考试中犯了一个令人不愉快的错误。

exampleEn: An unpleasant feeling is always bad.
exampleZh: 一种令人不愉快的感受总是不好的。

definition: 敌对的；不友好的；不利的
exampleEn: The medicine caused no adverse effects for me.
exampleZh: 这种药对我没有造成任何不利影响。

definition: 怀有敌意的；不友善的；敌对的
exampleEn: The customer became hostile during the conversation.
exampleZh: 在谈话过程中，顾客变得怀有敌意。

exampleEn: I was just a little indignant.
exampleZh: 我只是有点愤慨。

exampleEn: The basic components of Chinese characters are called "radicals".
exampleZh: 汉字的基本组成部分被称为‘部首’。

exampleEn: He was mad because he was not invited.
exampleZh: 他没有被邀请，因此非常生气。

exampleEn: It would be crazy to do that again.
exampleZh: 再次做那件事是非常愚蠢的。

exampleEn: It is wicked of you to do such things.
exampleZh: 你做这样的事情是非常缺德的。

exampleEn: The answer leads us to a vicious circle.
exampleZh: 这个答案引导我们进入了一个恶性循环。

exampleEn: You could say it that way, but it's quite vulgar.
exampleZh: 你说得通，但那实在有点粗俗。

exampleEn: You can never have too much ego.
exampleZh: 你永远也不会有太多的自尊。

exampleEn: I don't want to be selfish.
exampleZh: 我不想表现得那么自私。

exampleEn: She gives me a nasty look every time she sees me.
exampleZh: 每次她看到我，都会给我一个恶狠狠的眼神。
focusZh: 恶狠狠的眼神；下流的眼神

exampleEn: I got a makeup-induced rash.
exampleZh: 我因为化妆而起了皮疹。
focusZh: 化妆引起的皮疹；草率的结果

definition: 容变的；反复无常的；易挥发的
exampleEn: Is elemental mercury volatile?
exampleZh: 元素汞是易挥发的吗？

exampleEn: I had a really weird dream yesterday.
exampleZh: 我昨天做了一个非常怪诞的梦。

exampleEn: Excessive choice results in the inability to choose.
exampleZh: 过多的选择导致无法做出选择。

exampleEn: He caused his parents a lot of anxiety.
exampleZh: 他给他的父母带来了很多焦虑。

definition: 不安定的；焦躁不安的；不耐烦的
exampleEn: You've had a very restless night.
exampleZh: 你昨晚度过了一个非常不安的夜晚。

exampleEn: Even though someone came, she still remained uneasy.
exampleZh: 尽管有人来了，她仍然心神不安。

exampleEn: The terrible scene made him tremble in fear.
exampleZh: 那可怕的景象让他害怕地颤抖起来。

exampleEn: She is timid like a rabbit.
exampleZh: 她胆小得像一只兔子。

definition: 大惊小怪；无所谓的纷扰
exampleEn: Don't make a fuss about a small mistake.
exampleZh: 不要因为一个小错误而大惊小怪。

exampleEn: I didn't mean to insult her.
exampleZh: 我并不是有意要侮辱她。

definition: 不和善的；不仁慈的；刻薄的
exampleEn: Do you enjoy being unkind to everyone?
exampleZh: 你喜欢对每个人都表现得那么不友善吗？

exampleEn: I have to say I envy you guys.
exampleZh: 我得说我很羡慕你们。

exampleEn: Don't be jealous of the success of others.
exampleZh: 不要嫉妒别人的成功。

exampleEn: There's no doubt that the universe is infinite.
exampleZh: 毫无疑问，宇宙是无限的。

exampleEn: He was under suspicion of being a spy.
exampleZh: 他因为被怀疑是间谍而受到怀疑。

exampleEn: We're very skeptical.
exampleZh: 我们对这件事非常怀疑。

definition: 不能令人满意的；不符合要求的；不足的
exampleEn: On the whole, the result was unsatisfactory.
exampleZh: 总的来说，结果并不令人满意。
focusZh: 不能令人满意的；不符合要求的；不足的

definition: 不稳定的；易变的；不牢固的
exampleEn: People's emotional lives are becoming more and more unstable.
exampleZh: 人们的生活情感变得越来越不稳定。
focusZh: 不稳定的；易变的；不牢固的

exampleEn: The opacity of the glass made it unsuitable for windowpanes.
exampleZh: 玻璃的透明度使得它不适合用作窗户玻璃。

definition: 不愿意的；不情愿的；勉强的
exampleEn: I was unwilling to respond to her.
exampleZh: 我不愿意回应她。
focusZh: 不愿意的；不情愿的；勉强的

exampleEn: I am reluctant to talk about it.
exampleZh: 我不愿意谈论这件事。

exampleEn: Reporters do not hesitate to intrude into people's privacy.
exampleZh: 记者们毫不犹豫地侵犯人们的隐私。

definition: 使困惑；把（某人）弄糊涂；混淆
exampleEn: You're confusing me with somebody else.
exampleZh: 你把我同另一个人搞混了。

exampleEn: She declared that she was not guilty.
exampleZh: 她宣称自己无罪。

definition: 使尴尬，使窘迫，使局促不安
exampleEn: There's no need to be embarrassed.
exampleZh: 没有必要感到尴尬。

definition: 遗憾；抱歉；悲叹/后悔；痛惜；惋惜
exampleEn: He regrets not having worked harder at school.
exampleZh: 他后悔在学校没有更加努力地工作。

exampleEn: He repented having betrayed his country to the enemy.
exampleZh: 他后悔背叛了自己的国家，向敌人投降。

exampleEn: You have no need to be ashamed.
exampleZh: 你不必感到羞愧。
focus: have no need to be ashamed

exampleEn: I sighed with relief to hear it.
exampleZh: 听到这个消息，我如释重负地叹了口气。

exampleEn: My mother did nothing but weep.
exampleZh: 我的母亲除了哭泣什么也不做。

exampleEn: I have a low tolerance for pain.
exampleZh: 我对疼痛的忍受能力很低。

definition: 无知的；没有学识的；愚昧的
exampleEn: I am quite ignorant of the plan.
exampleZh: 我对这个计划一无所知。

exampleEn: I cannot endure being disturbed in my work.
exampleZh: 我无法忍受在工作时被打扰。

exampleEn: He did it on the sly.
exampleZh: 他偷偷摸摸地做了这件事。

exampleEn: People say that the fox is more cunning than other animals.
exampleZh: 人们说狐狸比其他动物更狡猾。

exampleEn: We can't tolerate such an arbitrary act.
exampleZh: 我们无法容忍这种武断的行为。

exampleEn: It would be ridiculous to spend all their money.
exampleZh: 花光所有的钱真是太荒谬了。

definition: 愚蠢的；麻木的；乏味的/傻瓜；笨蛋
exampleEn: I don't want to marry a stupid man!
exampleZh: 我不想嫁给一个愚蠢的男人！

definition: 笨拙的；尴尬的；棘手的；不合适的
exampleEn: He is awkward in his movements.
exampleZh: 他的动作很笨拙。

exampleEn: I apologize for being so clumsy.
exampleZh: 我为自己的笨拙道歉。

definition: 粗心的；无忧无虑的；淡漠的
exampleEn: A careless person is apt to make mistakes.
exampleZh: 一个粗心的人很容易犯错。

exampleEn: I was oblivious to the whole thing.
exampleZh: 我对此事一无所知。

exampleEn: I can't stand naughty children.
exampleZh: 我无法忍受那些淘气的孩子。

exampleEn: I'm not greedy.
exampleZh: 我不贪婪。

definition: 过分炫耀的；过分突出的；扎眼的
exampleEn: He tried to be less obtrusive.
exampleZh: 他试图不那么引人注目。

exampleEn: A slothful routine can make you feel less energetic.
exampleZh: 一个懒散的常规会让你感觉不那么有活力。

exampleEn: I just felt slow and sluggish.
exampleZh: 我感到自己行动迟缓且无力的。

exampleEn: I felt an impulse to cry out loud.
exampleZh: 我感到一种冲动的情绪，想要大声哭出来。

exampleEn: He was rigid with terror.
exampleZh: 他因恐惧而变得僵硬。

exampleEn: Facts are stubborn things, but statistics are pliable.
exampleZh: 事实是顽固的，但统计数据是灵活的。

definition: 老一套；模式化观念；刻板印象
exampleEn: This program has become stereotyped.
exampleZh: 这个节目已经变得模式化了。

exampleEn: The exchange rates for foreign currency change daily.
exampleZh: 外汇汇率每日都会变动。

exampleEn: How much is your monthly gas bill?
exampleZh: 你的每月天然气账单是多少？

exampleEn: We review our budget on a quarterly basis.
exampleZh: 我们按季度审查我们的预算。

exampleEn: The company completed its annual audit last week.
exampleZh: 公司上周完成了其年度审计。

exampleEn: I prefer to have a yearly eye exam.
exampleZh: 我更喜欢每年进行一次眼科检查。

exampleEn: Anniversaries are important.
exampleZh: 周年纪念日很重要。

exampleEn: The current era is the atomic era.
exampleZh: 当前的时代是原子时代。

definition: 现在的/目前；礼物；赠送物
exampleEn: He is not content with his present salary.
exampleZh: 他对目前的薪水并不满意。

exampleEn: He's contemplating the complexity of contemporary life.
exampleZh: 他在思考当代生活的复杂性。

exampleEn: The course explains how feudalism shaped medieval society.
exampleZh: 这门课程解释了封建制度如何塑造了中世纪社会。

exampleEn: 2001 is the year when the 21st century begins.
exampleZh: 2001年是21世纪开始的年份。

exampleEn: We've already prepared for the millennium bug.
exampleZh: 我们已经为千年虫问题做好了准备。

exampleEn: Millions of people starve to death every year.
exampleZh: 每年都有数百万人饿死。

exampleEn: The population of China has already exceeded 1.3 billion.
exampleZh: 中国的人口已经超过了13亿。

exampleEn: I want a dozen cream puffs.
exampleZh: 我想买一打奶油泡芙。

exampleEn: I have exams from dawn till dusk.
exampleZh: 我从黎明一直考试到黄昏。

exampleEn: Will you be at home at midday today?
exampleZh: 你今天中午会在家吗？

exampleEn: I rarely stay awake past midnight.
exampleZh: 我很少在午夜之后还醒着。

exampleEn: We stayed overnight near the airport.
exampleZh: 我们在机场附近过了一夜。

exampleEn: I slept well last night.
exampleZh: 我昨晚睡得很好。

exampleEn: This apartment has a modern kitchen.
exampleZh: 这个公寓有一个现代化的厨房。

exampleEn: Have you seen her recent photos?
exampleZh: 你看过她的最近照片吗？

exampleEn: It is essential to keep software up-to-date to prevent security risks.
exampleZh: 保持软件处于最新版本对于防止安全风险至关重要。

exampleEn: I played tennis yesterday for the first time.
exampleZh: 我昨天第一次打网球。

exampleEn: Secondly, we need to check the budget.
exampleZh: 其次，我们需要检查预算。

exampleEn: The truth finally came out at his trial.
exampleZh: 真相最终在他的审判中揭露。

definition: 完成；结束/结尾；最后部分
exampleEn: She finished her work an hour in advance.
exampleZh: 她提前一个小时完成了她的工作。

exampleEn: His heart stopped beating and he died immediately.
exampleZh: 他的心脏停止了跳动，他立即就死了。

exampleEn: I had instant noodles as a midnight snack.
exampleZh: 我作为午夜小吃吃了即食面。

exampleEn: Can you wait a moment?
exampleZh: 你能稍等片刻吗？

exampleEn: Give me a minute to check.
exampleZh: 请给我一会儿时间检查。

exampleEn: I have no prior experience with this software.
exampleZh: 我对这个软件没有以前的经验。

exampleEn: Lincoln greeted his former political rival.
exampleZh: 林肯问候了他的前政治对手。

exampleEn: Please read the preceding paragraph again.
exampleZh: 请再次阅读上一段。

exampleEn: This decision could set a dangerous precedent.
exampleZh: 这个决定可能树立一个危险的先例。

exampleEn: I want cake, first and foremost.
exampleZh: 我想要蛋糕，首要的是。

exampleEn: There's an opening on our sales team.
exampleZh: 我们的销售团队有一个空缺职位。

exampleEn: It was much worse than we initially thought.
exampleZh: 这比我们最初想象的要糟糕得多。

exampleEn: My level in English is intermediate.
exampleZh: 我的英语水平是中级。

exampleEn: Algeria is in the midst of a political crisis.
exampleZh: 阿尔及利亚正处于政治危机之中。

definition: [in the ~]其间；同时/[for the ~]眼下；暂时
exampleEn: The repair will take an hour; wait here in the meantime.
exampleZh: 修理期间，请在这里等待。

exampleEn: Meanwhile, the circumstances have changed drastically.
exampleZh: 与此同时，情况已经发生了巨大变化。

exampleEn: I want to become a simultaneous interpreter.
exampleZh: 我希望成为一名同声传译员。

exampleEn: It's an ongoing investigation.
exampleZh: 这是一项正在进行中的调查。

exampleEn: I'm tired of your everlasting grumbles.
exampleZh: 我厌倦了你那永无止境的抱怨。

exampleEn: Are you looking for a permanent job?
exampleZh: 您在寻找一份永久性的工作吗？

exampleEn: Please be punctual for tomorrow's meeting.
exampleZh: 请明天会议时准时。

exampleEn: Gradually increase the duration of your workouts.
exampleZh: 逐渐增加你锻炼的持续时间。

exampleEn: It snowed for ten consecutive days.
exampleZh: 雪连续下了十天。

exampleEn: The system checks for updates periodically.
exampleZh: 系统会定期检查更新。

definition: （尤指不愉快的事）即将发生的；逼近的
exampleEn: He prepared for his imminent departure.
exampleZh: 他准备迎接即将到来的离开。

exampleEn: Incidentally, I have to tell you something.
exampleZh: 顺便告诉你一件事。

exampleEn: The two companies decided to merge to expand their market share.
exampleZh: 两家公司决定合并以扩大市场份额。

exampleEn: The desert nomad traveled from oasis to oasis.
exampleZh: 沙漠游牧者在绿洲之间辗转前行。
